{{Quote|Did you co-ordinate the ''homing transmitters''?''"<br />"''Yes, General. The ''fleet'' should be able to triangulate on the base even through its ''cloaking shields'' now!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Thill]]|<ref name="Downhill" />}}
A '''mission to Felucia''' took place in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] set out to destroy a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Felucia Separatist base|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
